نستقال (form X)
# نُسْتَقَالُ (nustaqālu) /nus.ta.qaː.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقَالَ (istaqāla)
# نُسْتَقَالَ (nustaqāla) /nus.ta.qaː.la/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَقَالَ (istaqāla)
